_comment: Launch entries for the Delivery Console. Paths are relative to the workspace root. Read by editor/agent launchers per desktop/README.md and T-003-decision-log.md; no code path in this repo consumes it. T-015 moved `console-serve` to the documented runtimeExecutable/runtimeArgs/port schema so a preview pane can start it — carrying both key sets made the launcher concatenate them into one broken argv. `desktop-shell` keeps program/args: it is a path to an exe, not a server with a port.

configurations.name: desktop-shell
configurations.description: Launch the release build of the Tauri desktop shell (Windows). Build first: cargo build --release --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml

configurations.name: console-serve
configurations.description: Launch the console's own HTTP server directly (browser-only, no Tauri shell).
